name: std-dungeon-board-2d
description: 2D key-move dungeon-crawl board FRAME: composes hero-nav (key-move intent) + dungeon-combat (bump-attack, monster chase, hero HP) + objective-reach (exit/chest) + fx-particles + objective-flow (win) onto one shared GameState with a canvas-2d render. Games consume this molecule and supply only theme/assets/tiles/units/enemies/features via config.

schema.description: 2D key-move dungeon-crawl board FRAME: composes hero-nav (key-move intent) + dungeon-combat (bump-attack, monster chase, hero HP) + objective-reach (exit/chest) + fx-particles + objective-flow (win) onto one shared GameState with a canvas-2d render. Games consume this molecule and supply only theme/assets/tiles/units/enemies/features via config.
schema.name: std-dungeon-board-2d

gridHeight.description: Grid row count clamping move + wander bounds
gridHeight.label: Grid Height

gridWidth.description: Grid column count clamping move + wander bounds
gridWidth.label: Grid Width

moveBudget.description: Moves the hero may spend before the round is lost if objectives remain
moveBudget.label: Move Budget

running.description: When true, MOVE/WANDER intents are applied; toggle to freeze the board
running.label: Running

tiles.description: Grid tiles used for passability checks (auto-generated all-passable when empty)
tiles.label: Tiles

units.description: Seed roster: the player hero plus any neutral NPCs
units.label: Initial Units

emits.description: Hero moved onto tile (x,z) with movesLeft remaining; objective mechanics listen to score progress and round-flow to decide win/lose

events.description: Hero moved onto tile (x,z) with movesLeft remaining; objective mechanics listen to score progress and round-flow to decide win/lose
events.name: Hero Stepped

attackDamage.description: Damage dealt to an enemy per bump-attack
attackDamage.label: Attack Damage

gridHeight.description: Grid row count clamping enemy chase bounds
gridHeight.label: Grid Height

gridWidth.description: Grid column count clamping enemy chase bounds
gridWidth.label: Grid Width

pointsPerKill.description: Score awarded when an enemy's health reaches zero
pointsPerKill.label: Points Per Kill

running.description: When true, ATTACK/MONSTER_TICK intents are applied; toggle to freeze combat
running.label: Running

startHp.description: Hero HP set on INIT/RESTART (also used as maxHp)
startHp.label: Start HP

tiles.description: Grid tiles used for enemy chase passability checks
tiles.label: Tiles

emits.description: An enemy died from a bump-attack; a fx-particles listener spawns an explosion
Hero HP reached zero from monster contact damage

events.description: An enemy died from a bump-attack; a fx-particles listener spawns an explosion
events.name: Burst

events.description: Hero HP reached zero from monster contact damage
events.name: Defeated

features.description: Board features — collectible targets (matched by targetType) plus decorations
features.label: Features

reachRadius.description: Manhattan distance at which a target counts as reached: 0 = step onto the tile (collect), 1 = adjacent (deliver)
reachRadius.label: Reach Radius

removeOnReach.description: When true the target model is removed once reached (collect); when false it is flagged done and stays (visit/deliver)
removeOnReach.label: Remove On Reach

running.description: When true, hero steps onto targets are scored; toggle to freeze
running.label: Running

targetType.description: Feature type counted as a collectible objective
targetType.label: Target Type

emits.description: Pickup particle produced when a target is reached; a fx-particles listener spawns it
Objectives remaining + moves remaining after this step; a round-flow listener decides win/lose

events.description: Pickup particle produced when a target is reached; a fx-particles listener spawns it
events.name: Burst

events.description: Objectives remaining + moves remaining after this step; a round-flow listener decides win/lose
events.name: Progress

decayRate.description: Ttl units removed from every fx entry each tick; higher fades particles faster.
decayRate.label: Decay Rate

fx.description: Seed particles rendered before the first BURST; usually empty.
fx.label: Initial Fx

running.description: When true the decay tick runs; toggle to freeze effects.
running.label: Running

running.description: When true, PROGRESS signals resolve win/lose; toggle to freeze
running.label: Running

emits.description: Emitted for parity with round-flow when the round resolves; listeners may react to end-of-round

events.description: Emitted for parity with round-flow when the round resolves; listeners may react to end-of-round
events.name: Game End

fxPresets.description: This board's effect vocabulary — one look/recipe row per fx type its mechanics emit; unknown types fall back to a neutral spark.
fxPresets.label: Fx Presets

emits.description: Hero move intent applied by the hero-nav authority
Bump-attack intent applied by the dungeon-combat authority
Advances enemy chase AI and applies hero contact damage via the dungeon-combat authority
Resets every mechanic (units/enemies/HP, objectives, result) for a new run

events.description: Resets every mechanic (units/enemies/HP, objectives, result) for a new run
events.name: Play Again

events.description: Hero move intent applied by the hero-nav authority
events.name: Move

events.description: Bump-attack intent applied by the dungeon-combat authority
events.name: Attack

events.description: Advances enemy chase AI and applies hero contact damage via the dungeon-combat authority
events.name: Monster Tick

  trait DungeonIntent -> GameState [interaction, instance] {
    initial: playing

    state playing {
      INIT -> playing
        (render-ui main {
          type: game-shell
          fontFamily: @config.fontFamily
          backgroundAsset: @config.backgroundAsset
          hudBackgroundAsset: @config.hudBackgroundAsset
          hud: { type: game-hud, stats: [ { label: "HP", value: @entity.hp, max: @entity.maxHp, format: "hearts" }, { label: "Score", value: (+ @entity.score @entity.combatScore) } ] }
          controls: { type: control-grid, kind: "dpad", directionEvents: { up: "MOVE_UP", down: "MOVE_DOWN", left: "MOVE_LEFT", right: "MOVE_RIGHT" }, directionAssets: @config.directionAssets }
          overlay: (if (!= @entity.result "none") { type: game-menu, title: "VICTORY", subtitle: "You found the chest!", options: [ { id: "again", label: "Play Again", event: "PLAY_AGAIN", variant: "primary" } ] } (if (!= @entity.combatResult "none") { type: game-menu, title: "DEFEAT", subtitle: "The dungeon claims another hero", options: [ { id: "again", label: "Play Again", event: "PLAY_AGAIN", variant: "primary" } ] } null))
          children: [ { type: canvas, fit: true, camera: { zoom: @config.scale }, projection: "flat", showMinimap: false, keyMap: { ArrowUp: "MOVE_UP", KeyW: "MOVE_UP", ArrowDown: "MOVE_DOWN", KeyS: "MOVE_DOWN", ArrowLeft: "MOVE_LEFT", KeyA: "MOVE_LEFT", ArrowRight: "MOVE_RIGHT", KeyD: "MOVE_RIGHT" }, children: [
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map @entity.tiles (fn t { type: draw-shape, shape: "cell", position: { x: (object/get @t x), y: (object/get @t y) }, fill: "#5c94fc" })) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/map @entity.tiles (fn t { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get @t x), y: (object/get @t y) }, asset: (if (object/get (object/get @t terrainSprite) url) (object/get @t terrainSprite) (object/get (object/get @config.assetManifest terrains) (object/get @t terrain))), anchor: "center", width: 1, height: 1 })) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/map @entity.features (fn f { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get @f x), y: (object/get @f y) }, asset: (object/get @f sprite) })) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/map (array/concat @entity.units @entity.enemies) (fn u { type: draw-sprite, position: (object/get @u position), asset: (if (object/get (object/get @u sprite) url) (object/get @u sprite) (object/get (object/get @config.assetManifest units) (object/get @u unitType))), anchor: "ground", width: 1, height: 1 })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map (array/concat @entity.units @entity.enemies) (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: (object/get @u position), anchor: "ground", offsetX: -0.25, offsetY: -0.6, width: 0.5, height: 0.12, fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)" })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map (array/concat @entity.units @entity.enemies) (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: (object/get @u position), anchor: "ground", offsetX: -0.25, offsetY: -0.6, width: (* 0.5 (/ (object/get @u health) (object/get @u maxHealth))), height: 0.12, fill: "#22c55e" })) }
            { type: draw-text-layer, items: (array/map (array/concat @entity.units @entity.enemies) (fn u { type: draw-text, text: (object/get @u name), position: (object/get @u position), offsetY: -0.85, color: "#ffffff" })) }
            { type: draw-fx-layer, items: @entity.fx, tickMs: 500, presets: @config.fxPresets, sprites: (object/get @config.assetManifest effects) }
          ] } ]
        })

      MOVE_UP -> playing when (and (== @entity.result "none") (== @entity.combatResult "none"))
        (let ((hero (array/find @entity.units (fn u (== @u.id "hero")))))
          (let ((nx (object/get (object/get @hero position) x)) (ny (- (object/get (object/get @hero position) y) 1)))
            (let ((targetEnemy (array/find @entity.enemies (fn e (and (> @e.health 0) (and (== (object/get (object/get @e position) x) @nx) (== (object/get (object/get @e position) y) @ny)))))) (tile (array/find @entity.tiles (fn t (and (== (object/get @t x) @nx) (== (object/get @t y) @ny))))))
              (if (!= @targetEnemy null)
                (emit ATTACK { targetId: (object/get @targetEnemy id) })
                (if (and (grid/in-bounds { x: @nx, y: @ny } @config.gridWidth @config.gridHeight) (== (if (== @tile null) false (object/get @tile passable)) true))
                  (emit MOVE { unitId: "hero", x: @nx, y: @ny })
                  true)))))

      MOVE_DOWN -> playing when (and (== @entity.result "none") (== @entity.combatResult "none"))
        (let ((hero (array/find @entity.units (fn u (== @u.id "hero")))))
          (let ((nx (object/get (object/get @hero position) x)) (ny (+ (object/get (object/get @hero position) y) 1)))
            (let ((targetEnemy (array/find @entity.enemies (fn e (and (> @e.health 0) (and (== (object/get (object/get @e position) x) @nx) (== (object/get (object/get @e position) y) @ny)))))) (tile (array/find @entity.tiles (fn t (and (== (object/get @t x) @nx) (== (object/get @t y) @ny))))))
              (if (!= @targetEnemy null)
                (emit ATTACK { targetId: (object/get @targetEnemy id) })
                (if (and (grid/in-bounds { x: @nx, y: @ny } @config.gridWidth @config.gridHeight) (== (if (== @tile null) false (object/get @tile passable)) true))
                  (emit MOVE { unitId: "hero", x: @nx, y: @ny })
                  true)))))

      MOVE_LEFT -> playing when (and (== @entity.result "none") (== @entity.combatResult "none"))
        (let ((hero (array/find @entity.units (fn u (== @u.id "hero")))))
          (let ((nx (- (object/get (object/get @hero position) x) 1)) (ny (object/get (object/get @hero position) y)))
            (let ((targetEnemy (array/find @entity.enemies (fn e (and (> @e.health 0) (and (== (object/get (object/get @e position) x) @nx) (== (object/get (object/get @e position) y) @ny)))))) (tile (array/find @entity.tiles (fn t (and (== (object/get @t x) @nx) (== (object/get @t y) @ny))))))
              (if (!= @targetEnemy null)
                (emit ATTACK { targetId: (object/get @targetEnemy id) })
                (if (and (grid/in-bounds { x: @nx, y: @ny } @config.gridWidth @config.gridHeight) (== (if (== @tile null) false (object/get @tile passable)) true))
                  (emit MOVE { unitId: "hero", x: @nx, y: @ny })
                  true)))))

      MOVE_RIGHT -> playing when (and (== @entity.result "none") (== @entity.combatResult "none"))
        (let ((hero (array/find @entity.units (fn u (== @u.id "hero")))))
          (let ((nx (+ (object/get (object/get @hero position) x) 1)) (ny (object/get (object/get @hero position) y)))
            (let ((targetEnemy (array/find @entity.enemies (fn e (and (> @e.health 0) (and (== (object/get (object/get @e position) x) @nx) (== (object/get (object/get @e position) y) @ny)))))) (tile (array/find @entity.tiles (fn t (and (== (object/get @t x) @nx) (== (object/get @t y) @ny))))))
              (if (!= @targetEnemy null)
                (emit ATTACK { targetId: (object/get @targetEnemy id) })
                (if (and (grid/in-bounds { x: @nx, y: @ny } @config.gridWidth @config.gridHeight) (== (if (== @tile null) false (object/get @tile passable)) true))
                  (emit MOVE { unitId: "hero", x: @nx, y: @ny })
                  true)))))

      PLAY_AGAIN -> playing
        (emit RESTART { id: "board" })
    }

    ticks {
      renderTick every 100ms
        (render-ui main {
          type: game-shell
          fontFamily: @config.fontFamily
          backgroundAsset: @config.backgroundAsset
          hudBackgroundAsset: @config.hudBackgroundAsset
          hud: { type: game-hud, stats: [ { label: "HP", value: @entity.hp, max: @entity.maxHp, format: "hearts" }, { label: "Score", value: (+ @entity.score @entity.combatScore) } ] }
          controls: { type: control-grid, kind: "dpad", directionEvents: { up: "MOVE_UP", down: "MOVE_DOWN", left: "MOVE_LEFT", right: "MOVE_RIGHT" }, directionAssets: @config.directionAssets }
          overlay: (if (!= @entity.result "none") { type: game-menu, title: "VICTORY", subtitle: "You found the chest!", options: [ { id: "again", label: "Play Again", event: "PLAY_AGAIN", variant: "primary" } ] } (if (!= @entity.combatResult "none") { type: game-menu, title: "DEFEAT", subtitle: "The dungeon claims another hero", options: [ { id: "again", label: "Play Again", event: "PLAY_AGAIN", variant: "primary" } ] } null))
          children: [ { type: canvas, fit: true, camera: { zoom: @config.scale }, projection: "flat", showMinimap: false, keyMap: { ArrowUp: "MOVE_UP", KeyW: "MOVE_UP", ArrowDown: "MOVE_DOWN", KeyS: "MOVE_DOWN", ArrowLeft: "MOVE_LEFT", KeyA: "MOVE_LEFT", ArrowRight: "MOVE_RIGHT", KeyD: "MOVE_RIGHT" }, children: [
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map @entity.tiles (fn t { type: draw-shape, shape: "cell", position: { x: (object/get @t x), y: (object/get @t y) }, fill: "#5c94fc" })) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/map @entity.tiles (fn t { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get @t x), y: (object/get @t y) }, asset: (if (object/get (object/get @t terrainSprite) url) (object/get @t terrainSprite) (object/get (object/get @config.assetManifest terrains) (object/get @t terrain))), anchor: "center", width: 1, height: 1 })) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/map @entity.features (fn f { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get @f x), y: (object/get @f y) }, asset: (object/get @f sprite) })) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/map (array/concat @entity.units @entity.enemies) (fn u { type: draw-sprite, position: (object/get @u position), asset: (if (object/get (object/get @u sprite) url) (object/get @u sprite) (object/get (object/get @config.assetManifest units) (object/get @u unitType))), anchor: "ground", width: 1, height: 1 })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map (array/concat @entity.units @entity.enemies) (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: (object/get @u position), anchor: "ground", offsetX: -0.25, offsetY: -0.6, width: 0.5, height: 0.12, fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)" })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map (array/concat @entity.units @entity.enemies) (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: (object/get @u position), anchor: "ground", offsetX: -0.25, offsetY: -0.6, width: (* 0.5 (/ (object/get @u health) (object/get @u maxHealth))), height: 0.12, fill: "#22c55e" })) }
            { type: draw-text-layer, items: (array/map (array/concat @entity.units @entity.enemies) (fn u { type: draw-text, text: (object/get @u name), position: (object/get @u position), offsetY: -0.85, color: "#ffffff" })) }
            { type: draw-fx-layer, items: @entity.fx, tickMs: 500, presets: @config.fxPresets, sprites: (object/get @config.assetManifest effects) }
          ] } ]
        })

      chaseTick every 900ms when (and (== @entity.result "none") (== @entity.combatResult "none"))
        (emit MONSTER_TICK { heroX: (object/get (object/get (array/find @entity.units (fn u (== @u.id "hero"))) position) x), heroY: (object/get (object/get (array/find @entity.units (fn u (== @u.id "hero"))) position) y) })
    }

    emits {
      MOVE -> external {
        unitId : string!
        x : number!
        y : number!
      }
        @description "Hero move intent applied by the hero-nav authority"
        @tier "domain"
      ATTACK -> external {
        targetId : string!
      }
        @description "Bump-attack intent applied by the dungeon-combat authority"
        @tier "domain"
      MONSTER_TICK -> external {
        heroX : number!
        heroY : number!
      }
        @description "Advances enemy chase AI and applies hero contact damage via the dungeon-combat authority"
        @tier "domain"
      MOVE_UP -> external {
        id : string
      }
        @description "Step north (keyMap or d-pad directionEvents)"
        @tier "domain"
      MOVE_DOWN -> external {
        id : string
      }
        @description "Step south (keyMap or d-pad directionEvents)"
        @tier "domain"
      MOVE_LEFT -> external {
        id : string
      }
        @description "Step west (keyMap or d-pad directionEvents)"
        @tier "domain"
      MOVE_RIGHT -> external {
        id : string
      }
        @description "Step east (keyMap or d-pad directionEvents)"
        @tier "domain"
      PLAY_AGAIN -> external {
        id : string
      }
        @description "Resets every mechanic (units/enemies/HP, objectives, result) for a new run"
        @tier "domain"
      RESTART -> external {
        id : string
      }
        @description "Broadcast reset consumed by hero-nav/dungeon-combat/objective-reach/objective-flow"
        @tier "domain"
    }

    config {
      gridWidth : number = 4
        @label "Grid Width"
        @description "Grid column count (matches HeroAuthority/Enemies.gridWidth)."
        @tier "presentation"
      gridHeight : number = 4
        @label "Grid Height"
        @description "Grid row count (matches HeroAuthority/Enemies.gridHeight)."
        @tier "presentation"
      scale : number = 1
        @label "Scale"
        @description "Canvas render scale."
        @tier "presentation"
      fontFamily : string = ""
        @label "Font Family"
        @description "game-shell font family (e.g. pixel)."
        @tier "presentation"
      fxPresets : [FxPreset] = [ { type: "explosion", color: "#fb923c", color2: "#7c2d12", shape: "ring", size: 0.85, count: 8, glow: 0.2, gravity: 0.4 }, { type: "pickup", color: "#ffe066", color2: "#fff4cc", shape: "spark", size: 0.4, count: 5, glow: 0.1, vy: -0.5 } ]
        @label "Fx Presets"
        @description "This board's effect vocabulary — one look/recipe row per fx type its mechanics emit; unknown types fall back to a neutral spark."
        @tier "presentation"
      assetManifest : AssetManifest = { terrains: {}, units: {}, features: {}, effects: {} }
        @label "Asset Manifest"
        @description "Terrain/unit/feature/effect sprite manifest."
        @tier "presentation"
      backgroundAsset : Asset = {}
        @label "Background Asset"
        @description "Game-shell background panel sprite (theme chrome)."
        @tier "presentation"
      hudBackgroundAsset : Asset = {}
        @label "HUD Background Asset"
        @description "HUD panel background sprite (theme chrome)."
        @tier "presentation"
      directionAssets : DirectionAssets = {}
        @label "Direction Assets"
        @description "D-pad direction icon sprites."
        @tier "presentation"
    }
  }

  page "/dungeon-board-2d" as DungeonBoard2DPage -> HeroAuthority, Enemies, Collector, FxDecay, RoundGate, DungeonIntent
